CHANGELOG updated in DEADWEIGHT: Fix: production dw_server has run with --no-auth and no IDUNA config since it was first deployed -- match results, ELO stats, and draft win-loss tracking were never once reported to IDUNA. Wired in the real (already-provisioned) DEADWEIGHT-SERVER/DEADWEIGHT-BOTS agent credentials, redeployed, and verified end to end against production (a real match's loss correctly incremented a test account's draft run). (sess-20260920-1908-24cb3558)
